steps.title: Academic Eligibility
steps.detail: Candidates must have completed 12th grade with a minimum of 60% in core subjects (PCM/PCB).

steps.title: Entrance Examination
steps.detail: Qualify through the National Entrance Test (NET) or our University Merit Exam held in May.

steps.title: Counseling & Fit
steps.detail: A personal interaction session to understand your goals and map them to our curriculum.

faqs.question: What is the deadline for applications?
faqs.answer: The primary application window closes on July 15th every year. Early birds can apply by March for scholarship eligibility.

faqs.question: Are international boards accepted?
faqs.answer: Yes, IB, A-Levels, and other international certifications are accepted upon verification of equivalency.

faqs.question: Can I apply for multiple courses?
faqs.answer: You can list up to 3 preferences in a single application form.
